title: CARBURETOR, SPARK PIPE, HOSES, SOLENOID & CHOKE
summary: Carburetor (base engine) on the intake manifold with its base gasket, the bolts and nuts that hold it down (with a torque sequence), the vent and vacuum hoses, the spark pipe (vacuum advance line) along the intake manifold, the idle stop solenoid on a bracket at the front of the engine, and the choke (thermostat/choke coil) on the intake manifold with its rod and clip to the carburetor choke lever. The carb is held by two long bolts and two nuts on manifold studs; the solenoid bracket is held by a nut and lock washer on the end of an engine bolt (no separate stud).

parts.name: HOSE
parts.name_expanded: Hose (carburetor vacuum port to spark pipe)

parts.name: GASKET
parts.name_expanded: Gasket – carburetor base (carb to intake manifold)

parts.name: CLIP L.H.
parts.name_expanded: Clip LH (choke rod to carburetor choke lever)

parts.name: CHOKE
parts.name_expanded: Choke (thermostatic choke coil assembly on intake manifold)

fastening.note: Bolt [1] (letter A) goes down through the carburetor [2] flange and base gasket [5] into the intake manifold. A second long bolt (letter C, no item number) does the same at the other corner. Follow the torque sequence: A and B to torque 1, C and D to torque 1, then retorque A-B and C-D to torque 4.
Nut [11] (letter B) and a second nut (letter D, no item number) go on manifold studs on top of the carburetor [2] flange, through the base gasket [5].
View A: screw [14] holds the choke [13] down; a tang under the choke housing locates it on the manifold.
View A: the choke [13] rod end is held in the carb lever by clip [12].
View B: the solenoid [8] bracket fits over an engine bolt in the '#4 hole' (engine-installed, no callout); lock washer [15] and nut [16] go on the protruding threaded end of that bolt.

Hoses push onto their fittings: vent hose [4] at the carburetor, hose [3] from a carburetor port to the spark pipe [6], hose [7] at the other end of the spark pipe near the solenoid, hose [9] at the back of the manifold (arrow B). No clamps shown.
Spark pipe [6] runs around the base of the carburetor along the manifold between hoses [3] and [7]; no retaining clip shown.

notes: TORQUE SEQUENCE: Torque bolt A and nut B to torque 1. Torque bolt C and nut D to torque 1. Retorque A B, C D in same sequence to torque 4.
